description: Frozen Branch A performance budgets from PA5 evidence. Hard limits fail CI; advisory limits warn only.

linkCoverage.hard: Homepage Lighthouse http-status-code plus bounded status checks for Home, Playground, and every generated public project route against the owned preview (status < 400).
linkCoverage.nonGating: External portfolio link availability is advisory only; third-party uptime is outside repository control.
linkCoverage.residualBoundary: Client-side SPA destinations are checked as same-origin HTML shell responses, not rendered route DOM. Rendered-DOM link traversal is out of scope without adding a second browser-driving stack.
